verdict.rationale: Warp provides AI-generated command suggestions, error explanations, natural-language-to-command generation, and an agent that writes code, runs commands, and interprets results — all surfaced directly inside the terminal product (e.g., '#' AI Command Suggestions, 'Ask Warp AI' error explain, Agent Mode conversations, MCP-based context pulling). This is well documented across multiple first-party docs pages. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation specifically of insight quality (community evidence focuses on reliability/privacy complaints rather than confirming suggestion usefulness), and no concrete example of a generated insight/output shown.
